svg.title: Disruption and recalibration — Xiaohongshu reach and account ban
svg.desc: A Xiaohongshu post documenting organic reach and a cropped platform notice showing the off-platform traffic rule category. The account received a ban, three appeals failed, and I recall some customers calling after finding the shop through its map listing; existing customers also returned.
svg.text: A channel that had begun to work—and the rule boundary that closed it
Notice crop shows the rule category; account identifier is not included.
After the ban, I did not rebuild the Xiaohongshu channel.
I recall some customers calling after finding the shop through its map listing; existing customers also returned. I had concentrated too many functions
on my own capacity and underestimated their combined weight. The store is no longer operating.
